verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in, in-product AI assistant that users can hand tasks to. Mercury's agent story is outward-facing: an MCP server, CLI skills and an API for connecting the user's own external AI tools. The in-product AI features (bill reading and auto-population, AI-powered bookkeeping automations, receipt auto-attach) are narrow automations, not a delegable assistant, so they earn no credit under the adjacent-feature rule.
